dog.description_text: Paradise is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Paradise, a three-year-old female, is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQCmlPvNMvboS78FTdEWHl-3AbWffTEWrDD5UkQm6WpjoB4?e=oIwo0c Paradise enjoys being pet and loves to play. Her foster says "Paradise is an absolute sweetheart. She has the sweetest biggest eyes and the way she looks at you will melt your heart. She’s a low maintenance girly who generally prefers affection on her terms but can be super cuddly when she wants to be. She will sit on your lap when she wants attention and stay put for extended periods of time and purr nonstop. She’s a pretty mellow cat overall and a consistent companion as soon as she feels connected with you. Before then she can be semi timid and will take a little bit of time to warm up but as soon as she trusts you, she is such a lover! Anyone who adopts her will be very lucky to have a loving dependable little buddy!" "Paradise was explorative and accepted pets right away when we got home! She is a sweet, chatty girl and loves to sleep in her green plush chair across from us when we watch TV, but occasionally does hop into our laps for cuddle time. She’s such a playful cat and loves to roll over on her back, look up at you!". She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call.
